Numblix

Slide. Plan. Solve.

Numblix is a sliding-number puzzle you can play offline. Plan your moves, slide the tiles into order and work up through larger boards.

Numblix is in development and not in any app store yet. Follow GenzLogic on GitHub for updates.

Category
Games
Platforms
iPhone

What Numblix does

  • Offline play

    A single-player puzzle that works without a connection.

  • Multiple board sizes

    Start small and work up to bigger grids.

  • More to come

    Themes, daily challenges and achievements are planned.
